description: This file defines the Minify_CSS class responsible for CSS minification, including regex-based whitespace removal, comment preservation, URL rewriting, and CSS value minimization.

classes.name: Minify_CSS
classes.description: A class providing static methods for compressing and minifying CSS code.

methods.name: minify
methods.description: Public static method to minify a CSS string with optional comment preservation and URL rewriting.

methods.name: _minify
methods.description: Protected static method that performs the actual minification process, including regex replacements and URL rewriting.

methods.name: _selectorsCB
methods.description: Helper method to remove whitespace around CSS selector combinators.

methods.name: _commentCB
methods.description: Callback to process CSS comments, preserving certain comments and handling hack modes.

methods.name: _urlCB
methods.description: Callback to process URLs within CSS, rewriting relative URLs based on options.

methods.name: _fontFamilyCB
methods.description: Callback to process font-family declarations, removing unnecessary whitespace.
